free_tier.stated: 10 GB of file storage for the whole workspace on Free

egress.terms: Free; files served from Pumble's own CDN

tooling: No public file API documented; web/desktop clients only. Wrapper would have to be scraped.
limits_note: 10 GB workspace total; storage counts uploads across channels, DMs and meeting recordings; at the limit you must delete files before uploading more
reliability_note: No documented retention deletion (unlike Slack), but no API either, so it is manual-only.

evidence.proved: table: 'Free plan | 10GB storage for the whole workspace'; 'Pro plan | 10GB storage per user seat'
